title: Cross-Body Scale Portability
negative_results: cross-body mixing of two coordinates from different bodies is refused
to_bodyfixed refuses when the coordinate's body_id does not match the target body
a coordinate without a body_id is refused
scale_cell_size_m refuses a non-positive cell size

claims.statement: The same addressing/codec API operates on Earth and Mars via BodyModel, differing only by declared constants and IAU convention (System Contract invariant 7).
A metric cell size maps between bodies by the equatorial-radius ratio scale factor, reversibly.
A coordinate carries its body_id and is never silently reused across bodies; crossing requires an explicit recorded conversion (MATHEMATICAL_TRANSLATION), which asserts nothing geographic.

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic fixtures only, no private inputs
